title: Fondamantal — Broadcast Platform
label: Media Publishing / Brand Communication
summary: A brand-owned publishing channel for updates and announcements, designed for consistency, permanence, and platform cohesion.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: The Broadcast Platform is Fondamantal's first-party communication layer—centralizing announcements and updates outside third-party algorithm constraints.

sections.title: The Problem
sections.body: External social platforms bury content, limit presentation consistency, and reduce long-term accessibility of important updates.

sections.title: The Solution
sections.body: A lightweight publishing system that preserves posts over time, maintains brand consistency, and integrates directly with the broader platform.

sections.title: Key Features
bullets: Content permanence compared to social feeds
Minimal UI focused on the message

sections.title: Outcome
sections.body: A stable, brand-owned channel that strengthens platform identity and reduces dependency on third-party distribution.

sections.title: Key Takeaway
sections.body: Owning the communication layer creates stability and long-term value.

cta.headline: Looking to own your content and communication?
cta.body: If you want a publishing system that fits your ecosystem, I can help design and build it.
